How Dash works, in plain terms:

Dash InstantSend uses masternode quorums to lock a payment in ~1s, trading added infrastructure and collateralized nodes for speed. Typical Bitcoin flows wait ~6 confirmations (~60 min), trading delay for pure PoW-only security.

Biggest leverage on Dash Platform isn't code speed—it's index design before registration. Contract schemas are append-only: skip an index now and adding it later means migrating every document. Map your queries first, write schema second.

Ask me anything:

Six proposals — kwvg dev funding and OrchardPay among them — sit at 25-27 net yes votes, while funded ones cleared 500-670. Not a persuasion gap, a visibility one: post the ballot in your MN group now — cutoff ~286h.
